description: Get paginated trade history for a specific politician. Returns individual STOCK Act disclosures with ticker, transaction type, amount range, filing delay, and late filing flag. Includes a summary with total buys/sells and net value.

slug.description: Politician URL slug (e.g., "sen-nancy-pelosi") Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only, exactly as returned by get_politicians (a name with spaces or capitals is rejected).

name: get_politician_transactions
title: Get Politician Transactions
